name: CP Capital Ltd

engine.excluded_on: asset quality (D6 GNPA hard floor), not valuation
engine.watch_condition: FY27 audited GNPA <12% with no fresh slippages; interim read Q2FY27 results ~Nov-2026

thesis: Microcap NBFC (₹282cr mcap) priced like a distressed asset but built like a fortress: CRAR 91.0%, D/E 0.13×, zero promoter pledge, profitable every year except the demerger year, FY26 P/E 6.6× and P/B 0.49×. The single load-bearing problem is asset quality — headline GNPA 17.28% at Mar-2026, dominated by one legacy ₹43.97cr Proseed exposure that was fully provided years ago and technically written off in Q1FY27 (legal recovery retained as upside). Adjusted GNPA was 7.66% at FY26-end and the published Q1FY27 print (14-Aug-2026) shows reported GNPA down to 8.9% (₹35.21cr), 99.9% secured with 2.5× coverage. The engine's hard floor is backward-looking by construction; the forward data says the specific cause of the veto is clearing. Not buyable under the veto — but the cleanup is monitorable with dated catalysts, hence WATCH, not PASS.
risks: **Asset quality is the whole thesis risk:** headline GNPA tripped the engine's hard floor; adjusted 7.66% still elevated; one more large slippage re-opens the veto
₹130.39cr related-party receivables sit inside the loan book (AR Note 7) — concentration/opacity
Microcap illiquidity: price moved 2×+ in months on ~4k–25k share volumes; entry/exit slippage real
Management is promoter-family dominated (Maheshwari family 63.77%); material RPTs a recurring AGM item
Historical financials polluted by the 2024 demerger/merger scheme; no concall track record found
Market-implied growth at −50% floor — the tape agrees with the veto, not the anchor
